# David Packer Reports Starting With Three To Five Minutes Rest Then Changing To One And A Half Minutes For Front Lever Pull-Ups In His Own Training

David Packer reports that at the beginning he started with three to five minutes rest for his front lever training, then changed it to one and a half minutes rest to make his workouts shorter. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

## Details

- At the beginning he always started off with long rest three to five minutes as his protocol. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- He changed it to one and a half minute rest to maximum two minutes because he wanted his workouts to be shorter. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- For front lever he never rested more than two minutes, always less than a minute or a minute or less. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

## Evidence

- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "at the beginning i always started off with long rest three to five minutes was the um was my protocol then i changed it um to one half minute rest to maximum two minutes"
- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "front lever i never rested more than two minutes is always less than a minute a minute or less"
